column1: # The Czech talking head of the reel flow: three takes as a phone records them, with restarted sentences,
# fillers at the start of a sentence, long pauses and a closing call to action. The fourth take, only in the
# first reel, has fillers and a hesitation inside sentences and a "jakoby" that means something. scripts/fixtures.sh
# speaks each phrase with espeak-ng and follows it with the pause; tests/e2e/reel.py knows from the role what a
# good rough cut keeps. Roles: keep; retake, an earlier attempt of a later sentence; filler-lead, a sentence
# that starts with a filler, which ends at the first pause of the phrase (espeak pauses about 0.2 s at a comma);
# filler-mid, a sentence with a filler between its two commas; hesitation, a sentence with an "eee" recognition
# does not write: the halves around "eee" are spoken apart, with 0.26 s of "eee" and 90 ms of quiet on either side.

column4: Dneska vám ukážu, jak natočit video
Dneska vám ukážu, jak natočit video za deset minut.
Mikrofon dejte co nejblíž k puse.
Jakoby, potom řešíte světlo z okna.
Kamera musí stát pevně na stativu.
Prostě, hotové video nahrajte na Instagram a TikTok.
Napište mi do komentáře, co chcete vidět příště.
Na začátku, ehm, řekněte své jméno.
Celé to zní jakoby z rádia.
